why_recorded_now: OG-ap-18 step 5 requires registry_before to be the count read BEFORE the deploy. The deploy is HELD (the issuer's msg 34207, the parents[5] import defect), so this reading is banked against the ref it was taken at rather than reconstructed later. If another release lands before the gt-8 re-cut deploys, this must be re-read: the field is 'the count before THIS deploy', not a constant.
a_defect_in_my_own_instrument_found_by_r: the harness's first run on the host died with ImportError: cannot import name 'harvest_typed' from 'app'. Its --registry-only mode imported the five typed modules at the top, and those modules do not exist on the host until this very release lands -- so the mode was unusable at the one moment the order needs it. Fixed by importing only app.tools for that mode. Same class as Z-S126: an instrument whose imports assume the post-deploy state cannot measure the pre-deploy state, and running it early is what surfaced it.
